class.name: SpinePathConstraintData
class.brief_description: Stores the setup pose for a path constraint.
class.description: Stores the setup pose for a path constraint. A path constraint adjusts constrained bones so they follow a path attachment on a slot. See [url]http://esotericsoftware.com/spine-path-constraints[/url] in the Spine User Guide.

method.name: get_bones
method.description: The bones that will be modified by this path constraint. Modifying the array has no effect.

method.name: get_mix_rotate
method.description: A percentage (0-1) that controls the mix between the constrained and unconstrained rotation.

method.name: get_mix_x
method.description: A percentage (0-1) that controls the mix between the constrained and unconstrained translation X.

method.name: get_mix_y
method.description: A percentage (0-1) that controls the mix between the constrained and unconstrained translation Y.

method.name: get_offset_rotation
method.description: An offset added to the constrained bone rotation.

method.name: get_position
method.description: The position along the path.

method.name: get_position_mode
method.description: The mode for positioning the first bone on the path.

method.name: get_rotate_mode
method.description: The mode for adjusting the rotation of the bones.

method.name: get_spacing
method.description: The spacing between bones.

method.name: get_spacing_mode
method.description: The mode for positioning the bones after the first bone on the path.

method.name: get_target
method.description: The slot whose path attachment will be used to constrained the bones.

method.name: set_mix_rotate
method.description: Sets the mix percentage between constrained and unconstrained rotation.

method.name: set_mix_x
method.description: Sets the mix percentage between constrained and unconstrained translation X.

method.name: set_mix_y
method.description: Sets the mix percentage between constrained and unconstrained translation Y.

method.name: set_offset_rotation
method.description: Sets the offset added to constrained bone rotation.

method.name: set_position
method.description: Sets the position along the path.

method.name: set_position_mode
method.description: Sets the mode for positioning the first bone on the path.

method.name: set_rotate_mode
method.description: Sets the mode for adjusting constrained bone rotation.

method.name: set_spacing
method.description: Sets the spacing between constrained bones.

method.name: set_spacing_mode
method.description: Sets the mode for positioning bones after the first bone on the path.

method.name: set_target
method.description: Sets the slot data whose path attachment drives this constraint.
